generic_lessons: A fail-closed dependency guard is a conditional limitation, not a demonstrated defect without a real trigger.
Follow existing-state early returns before attributing a later compare-before-write refusal to stale session data.
Temporary unavailability plus a repeated initialization path does not establish permanent failure.
In an actual new world, qualify the native new-game flag and resulting first action separately from saved-world migration.
Core and UI rosters can differ transiently because consumed off-map objects remain delayed; record their full identity and state rather than labeling roster entries live.
A completed-world reload cannot close a pending-action recovery failure.
scope_limit: One fresh newgame first capital, one normal production round and completed-world reload; not pending-intent recovery, all start conditions, long-run loyalty, completeTC or Steam82release. No source-audit patch adoption.
